title: Alien Eating Flatbread
description: A large golden alien with a smooth elongated head and large black eyes sits in a desert landscape under a colorful starry nebula sky. It holds a piece of flatbread in its hands while steam rises from a light blue bowl filled with more flatbread, with two semi-trucks parked nearby on a dirt road.
prompt: A majestic golden alien with a large smooth head and huge black eyes sits cross-legged in a barren desert, holding a piece of steaming flatbread. In front of it is a light blue bowl and large stacks of flatbread. Two semi-trucks are parked on a dirt road to the left. The background features a vibrant cosmic nebula sky filled with stars and colorful gas clouds in purple, teal, and orange tones, surreal scene, cinematic lighting.
